notes.title: Release 30.05.2019
notes.notes:
SKAT is a trick-taking card game with 3 players very similar to SPADES, and national game of Germany.

Every single hand, first the one who plays against 2 others  has to be determined. This is done by the auction (German: "Reizen") meaning betting and competing, player with strongest bet may define the Trump suit - but  plays against 2 others!

You'll find a step-by-step Tutorial clicking "Extras" > "Tutorial"
